$comment: Thresholds of pipeline:ign-match. PROVISIONAL (2026-10-01): chosen before looking at the score distribution, to be calibrated against the 15 approved rivers and the report's distributions, then recorded in DECISSIONS.md. coverage = fraction of a reach within bufferM of the lines carrying one IGN name; margin = coverage of the best name minus the runner-up. bufferM 250 follows the IGN gate (HydroRIVERS comes from a coarse grid, so positions are offset). line (owner rule, 2026-10-09): an approved river (pipeline:named) and an IGN stream (pipeline:ign-streams) run only where the IGN line of their name runs: a reach is on the line when its coverage is at least line.minCoverage; reaches below it, and unnamed reaches (at most line.maxGap in a row), are kept only between two such reaches. minCoverage 0.5: see pipeline/README.md (pipeline:named) for the calibration; ign-streams reports a sweep of it.
